info.name: Hotel Booking API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Hotel Booking API, with happy paths and error cases.

**Run order matters.** Use the Collection Runner (or `newman run`) top to bottom: the Admin folder resets and seeds the database, and later requests rely on that data and on the booking reference captured by *Create booking*.

Dates are computed automatically by the collection pre-request script (check-in 30 days from today, 3 nights), so the collection never goes stale.

After seeding, IDs are fixed: hotel 1 *Seaside Retreat* has rooms 1–6 (101, 102 single · 201, 202 double · 301, 302 deluxe); hotel 2 *City Central Hotel* has rooms 7–12. Capacities: single 1, double 2, deluxe 4.

item.name: Admin (test data)
item.description: Reset and seed the database. Run these first.

request.description: Removes all data (hotels, rooms, room types, bookings) and restarts ID sequences.
Resets, then inserts 3 room types, 2 hotels × 6 rooms and one sample booking `BK-SEED0001`. Idempotent.

exec: pm.test("Seeded 2 hotels and 12 rooms", () => { pm.expect(s.hotels).to.eql(2); pm.expect(s.rooms).to.eql(12); });

request.description: Returns hotels whose name contains the search term.

exec: pm.test("It is Seaside Retreat", () => pm.expect(b.data[0].name).to.eql("Seaside Retreat"));

item.description: Book a room and look bookings up by reference.

request.description: Books deluxe room 301 for 3 people. Returns 201 with a `Location` header. The confirmation email is logged by the API 2 seconds later.
Uses the reference captured by *Create booking*.

request.description: Room 301 is now taken for these nights, so only 302 remains.
Checking in on the previous guest's check-out day is allowed.
